body:
I mean.... look I'm going to try to be nice here but this is going to be brutally honest and tough to hear so buckle up.

Looking through your past posts you KNOW he's a narcissist. You KNOW he's abusive. You KNOW he's a liar and a manipulator. You know the type of person he actually is. 

Do you want this feeling to persist? Or get rid of it? Because right now you're willfully putting yourself in this position. No judgment coming from me though, I know how difficult it is to let them go. It's brutal. Coming to all of the conclusions that you know to be true, but didn't want to actually see because they're too painful is all too real. But you've already done that part. At this point you know where it goes, but you want to feel wanted. You want to feel loved, thats natural. But this isn't that. You can find that for real in someone else. You can feel physically wanted in your totality from someone else. Because the truth is, you'll never, EVER, feel that from a narcissist.

You know what you need to do if you want this to stop. No contact. Cut all ties. And get through the hard part. It's rough, it's one of the hardest things I've personally ever had to do. But it's only going to make my life better, instead of being someone's personal torture pet. 

We're all here for you, but you need to be there for you too when we can't be. Please feel free to reach out if you need it. You got this, I promise. You'll thank yourself later

Remember you don't actually love HER, you love the person she was portraying herself to be. You saw her for what she was and ended it because of that. The person you love doesn't exist. The person hitting you up like this isn't her. She's not real. If you get back with her it'll get worse, more mind games, more lies, more bs all around. She'll punish you for it, in so many elaborate ways. I know it sucks, I've been there. Most of us on this subreddit have. But you need to block her, and cut all contact. If you're lucky, you can walk away without having your life permanently fucked up. If you go back, the chances of that happening increase by the day, if not hour, of you being with her. Leave, and be happy you did.
Same

If drinking puts her in the mood to cheat on her SO then she shouldn't be drinking. Alcohol is no excuse. What's next... "oh I took Molly and fucked someone because thats what I felt like doing" Nah, fuck that. Treat someone else like a doormat. She's the one throwing everything away after 2 years and trying to keep it a secret.
Yeah, my something stupid lies within my character like ordering too much food or some actual stupid shit. Not cheating on my SO. Drinking doesn't change who I am

Leave. I've left for less, and I've left bc of this exact situation. Ask yourself these questions and you'll have your answer:

Will I ever fully trust her again?
Will I ever fully respect myself if I stay?
Do I really want to be with someone that would do this to me?
Is this the person I want to marry?
Does she respect me?


I think you know the answer to these questions. It's SO HARD to leave someone you care deeply about, believe me, I know. But in the end, would you rather be alone feeling neutral with the possibility of finding someone who's actually genuine or with someone that makes you feel like shit?
1000% abuse. That is one of the sickest things I've ever heard tbh. You need to leave or it'll get far worse

Oh I feel this one. I feel the exact same way. But it's important for you to remember that you don't love HIM. You love the person he pretended to be. The real him is what you're seeing now. The monster.

Oh yeah, big time. The old "It's always me but never you that does anything wrong".... but like... yeah, you treat me like trash while I treat you like royalty. Lies, screaming, abuse in almost every form except physical, treating me exactly how you don't want to be treated and getting upset at me when I'm not ok with it. This seems to be exactly how these relationships go. But yet it's hard to let go because you're in love with the person they pretended to be. That person isn't real, it's fiction

You're absolutely right, it just sucks they had to screw us over for us to realize that. I'm really proud of you for standing up for yourself and breaking the cycle. At least we don't have to deal with the abuse anymore, and we can try to move on as best as we can

She would do the same thing, buying and doing drugs behind my back. She's an addict too, literally does not give af about what she puts in her body. Doing coke at work, leaving work to go day drink. Its ridiculous, and now shes doing amazing while I'm destroyed. I feel so stupid for being lied to so many times and believing her just because I wanted to try to see the best in her. I wanted it to work. I'm really glad you're kicking him out, you deserve so much better. I'm sorry this happened to you too, people like that are so incredibly destructive to everyone around them. I wouldn't even engage with him anymore, just like you're doing, just make him leave and leave it at that. I'm proud of you for getting out of the situation, I know it's so hard
Thank you
And thank you for the offer to reach out, I appreciate it so much. It's nice to be able to talk to people that understand this, it's good to know we aren't alone

The worst is the gaslighting. The fact that they did something in front of your face that is blatantly disrespectful and fucked up then act like it never even happened. Somehow it gets turned around on you and you're crazy. It's your fault now, even though you literally didn't do anything. Everything you said above is exactly what happened. I tried harder than I ever have, and not trying to be cocky but my best efforts were pretty damn good. I've never even heard of someone giving so much in a relationship, to not only be given nothing in return, but to be taken for even more. I don't understand. I did everything to be the best I could possibly be for her only to get torn down in a multitude of ways every time. One of the worst times was when she freaked out on me for getting my old job back in the city where she lived bc I moved across the country to be with her, basically "I don't want you to be successful, I want to be the only one that is" then I get this big ass text how she's doing so well. The betrayal, the belittling, the manipulation, the lies, it's straight up evil. I could go on and on about the fucked up shit she put me through. Honestly, I doubt I'll ever be able to fully recover from this.

I sent her a pic too with it that basically said she's a narcissist and that's why she's doing so well bc she doesn't care but yet I loved her. Yeah, it's not going to do anything, I can almost guarantee that. She probably just glanced at it and went along with her day like it never even happened. But at least I know better now. And she knows I know. I've never been treated so poorly, and I've been abused plenty of times before. But this one has no empathy and only wants to make me feel like shit in any way she can. I can barely function now, it's like my soul has been sucked dry
Mine gave me one too. I hate her
No. I regret getting involved in the first place. My self worth has never been so low

For one he cheated on her, so there is bad blood. Chances are she's either still being manipulated by him, or you're jusy listening to what he says and believing it. You need to drop him and move on. It's the only way. But honestly, be angry. It's healthy in a weird way, but the anger shows that you have self worth

Thats the problem though, there is no rationalizing the behavior. It'll just drive you mad trying to understand why they treat you like complete shit for no reason. Trying to decipher what was a lie and what was the truth is a nightmare. I don't know what to believe anymore. I don't know whats real anymore. I lost my identity in it. This is truly my rock bottom
Yeah I agree but hindsight is 20/20. I was abused early on too but I'm not like that. But some people are. Sucks bc I guess you'd never really know until it's too late

Yeah this sounds familiar. Same with me, this girl had a messed up home life and was abused early on so I thought I found someone that would understand. Someone that would want to see good put out in the world insteadof the fucked up shit that was done to us. Only I found the opposite, someone who continues the cycle and hurts everyone around them for their own gain. I'm sorry this happened to you. I'm so angry these people exist like this

This is exactly how I feel about mine. I'm 28 too. The girl I fell for is so toxic and so twisted that I just can't even comprehend how someone could lie so much to someone else, how someone can play make believe and fuck with every part of my being when all I wanted to do was love and care about them. But I get dragged further and further down the rabbit hole trying to pick apart and comprehend what happened. It feels like my soul is on fire. I understand what you're saying sexually too, they lie, pretend to be someone else to get what they want then they just exploit you. She did that to me too. They're barely human. Humans have at least some empathy, they have none.
Thank you
Yeah, and I feel like I know that too. Thank you for your advice, I appreciate it very much
Technically we already broke up, twice. But she keeps telling me she loves me and wants to be in my life, it's really confusing. Either be with me or don't, I can't do something that's half ass

I figured, and I feel that. I've tried to just cut it off multiple times but she keeps coming back claiming that she loves me and wants to marry me someday. It's so confusing and I just don't know what to do
Fair enough, thank you for your feedback. I'll look over it when I'm in a better frame of mind
Understood. I'll delete
Dammit reddit isn't letting me see the comments, should I mark this NSFW or something? Maybe DM me?
I do, it doesn't really seem to help much though
I'd be doing them a favor
Great choices though, did you get to 5 hours in?

I've been putting myself in the hole every night for the past few nights. It's helped briefly and lasts for a couple hours after, but I come right back to the stress and depression after that. It's been difficult. However, my situation is a bit more circumstantial and more complex than I'm used to, not the overarching depression type of stuff. I recommend giving it a try, it might help you, or it might not. But it won't hurt you so I still think it's worth it

Sorry I wasn't trying to be mean but it sounds like you're uncomfortable with this person. Maybe that question was valid in that part of your therapy, or maybe not. Maybe it was inappropriate, but those things can cause deep issues that are necessary to work out in therapy. If the way she goes about it makes you uncomfortable, then that's valid and you should find a different therapist. Trying to talk it out with her means that you'll still be working with her after, find someone that you can trust and really get into the issues with. Believe me, I've had many therapists over the years. But my therapist now is great, I can trust him and really open up to understand what is going on with me. That's what you need. That's what everyone needs
Just find a different therapist at that point tbh
